stories.title: Chinese Hackers Use AI-Powered ARTEX to Target Over 200 Organizations Worldwide
stories.description: China-linked Vapor Panda used ARTEX AI agents to target over 200 organizations, with post-exploitation activity confirmed at nine.

stories.title: TeamViewer Flaw Lets Remote Computers Attack Users Who Connect to Control Them
stories.description: TeamViewer 15.83 fixes CVE-2026-111585, which lets malicious hosts crash remote viewers and may enable code execution on some platforms.

stories.title: PHP2Shell Attacks Root Palo Alto Firewalls but Fail Against WordPress

stories.title: WordPress RCE Flaw Draws Nearly 63,000 Attack Attempts in Just 24 Hours
stories.description: Attackers target a WordPress Core RCE flaw during upgrades, with Wordfence blocking 62,969 attempts in 24 hours. Patch available in 7.1.4.

stories.title: Passkeys Are Better Than Passwords. But They Are Not Enough.
stories.description: As organizations eliminate passwords, attackers will adapt. Instead of attacking the authenticator directly, they will look for opportunities around it.

stories.title: Bulletproof Host Virtualine Loses Its Domain to FBI Seizure

stories.title: Trezor Warns of Suspected Hardware Implant in One of Its Wallets Sold by CryptoBilis
